نبياض (form XI)
# نَبْيَاضُّ (nabyāḍḍu) /nab.jaːdˤ.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
# نَبْيَاضَّ (nabyāḍḍa) /nab.jaːdˤ.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
# نَبْيَاضِّ (nabyāḍḍi) /nab.jaːdˤ.dˤi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
